name: vLLM documentation: Disaggregated Prefilling (experimental)
notes: States plainly that the feature is experimental, that 'Disaggregated prefill DOES NOT improve throughput', and that vLLM relies on third-party connectors (ExampleConnector, LMCacheConnectorV1, NixlConnector) for production-level disaggregated prefilling. Evidence that prefill/decode disaggregation is shipped but NOT a default or a throughput win.
